sanskrit: dantyāsyo'yaṃ haṭhādyaḥ śamayatu duritaṃ śaktijanmā gaṇeśaḥ || 1 ||
labdhuṃ ca pūrṇabhāvaṃ yadi cetaḥ samupādhvamimām || 4 ||
santamemi samabhāvadaṃ śivaṃ sakhyahāniramunā hi sūyate || 5 ||
yau mithaḥ samuditāvihonmukhau tau ṣaḍadhvapitarau śraye śivau || 6 ||
pratyahaṃ janani yatra tiṣṭhati tvaṃ sa sattvavapuradrirasya yaḥ || 12 ||
tāvakaṃ padamapākṛtakramaṃ brahma tatsaditi vā śrutaṃ bhaje || 14 ||
syāt tamaśca yadidaṃ niṣiddhyate dve rajo sadasadanyarūpataḥ || 16 ||
jñānamasya śuci karma vā phalaṃ te virāgamayapūrṇatāphale || 18 ||
dhūmalakṣmaguru yacca taccyutaṃ te tu sattvatamasī vapustava || 19 ||
pūrṇameva tava rūpamanyathā kurvatī kila kuhūḥ pratīyase || 21 ||
tvatsvarūpamakalaṅkitaṃ tayā kasya devi viduṣo na muktatā || 23 ||
akramaṃ śivamavekṣya madhyagaṃ tvāṃ ca satkulamidaṃ tavānanam || 24 ||
yā sthitāmba bahirakṣakāṅkṣiṇī tāṃ jahi tvamaṇutāṃ mayi sthitām || 25 ||
vṛttibhistava vilāpyate hi tad devi ! bhānurucibhiryathā tamaḥ || 26 ||
muktabāhyapadajṛmbhaṇodyamāḥ tvaṃ hi tiṣṭhasi tadūrdhvage pathi || 28 ||
vāgiyaṃ trividhabhāvabhāsitā tvāṃ sa vakti kimutāmba vaikharī || 30 ||
yattadūrdhvaśikhare paraṃ nabhastatra darśaya śivaṃ tvamambike || 32 ||
tatra te ya udayaḥ kuleśi ! taṃ sṛṣṭirāśrayati pañcavāhatā || 34 ||
sarva eva śaśinaḥ kalāḥ śive yonayo vidhṛtabījatatsvarāḥ || 40 ||
nāda iṣṭatanurasya kāraṇaṃ | tvaṃ pare ! tritayadharmarūpiṇī || 42 ||
tvaṃ śivādakulataḥ sameyuṣī tena tatra punareṣi viśramam || 46 ||
unmanīṃ smarati yastavākṛtiṃ siddhavartmani jayatyasau janaḥ || 48 ||
yaḥ prakāśa iha sa tvayā kṛtaḥ tattadākṛtirūpaiti sṛṣṭitām || 49 ||
śiṣyase yadi vinārthamaṇḍalaṃ sargasīmani kuto'sti cittatā || 50 ||
cittadākṛtinirākṛtiḥ svato bhāti yā sakṛdasau tvameva sā || 54 ||
tvaṃ tu jāḍyaparipanthinī smṛtā yā vibhāsi sakṛdarthamaṇḍale || 55 ||

grāhakatvamapi niścitagrahe vettyataḥ sa tava vṛttipoṣitaḥ || 60 ||
arpaṇena jagataścidambare bhāti saṃhṛtimayaḥ śive tava || 62 ||
ṣaṭ tvayā pṛthagamī pravartakāḥ putrabhāvamadhiropitāḥ śive || 65 ||
turyacitpadamayuḥ prasāritāḥ suptitaḥ prabhṛti dhāmasu triṣu || 71 ||

pūrṇameva tava rūpamanyathā kurvatī kila kuhūḥ pratīyase || 21 ||
tvatsvarūpamakalaṅkitaṃ tayā kasya devi viduṣo na muktatā || 23 ||
akramaṃ śivamavekṣya madhyagaṃ tvāṃ ca satkulamidaṃ tavānanam || 24 ||
yā sthitāmba bahirakṣakāṅkṣiṇī tāṃ jahi tvamaṇutāṃ mayi sthitām || 25 ||
vṛttibhistava vilāpyate hi tad devi ! bhānurucibhiryathā tamaḥ || 26 ||
muktabāhyapadajṛmbhaṇodyamāḥ tvaṃ hi tiṣṭhasi tadūrdhvage pathi || 28 ||
vāgiyaṃ trividhabhāvabhāsitā tvāṃ sa vakti kimutāmba vaikharī || 30 ||
yattadūrdhvaśikhare paraṃ nabhastatra darśaya śivaṃ tvamambike || 32 ||
tatra te ya udayaḥ kuleśi ! taṃ sṛṣṭirāśrayati pañcavāhatā || 34 ||
sarva eva śaśinaḥ kalāḥ śive yonayo vidhṛtabījatatsvarāḥ || 40 ||
nāda iṣṭatanurasya kāraṇaṃ | tvaṃ pare ! tritayadharmarūpiṇī || 42 ||
tvaṃ śivādakulataḥ sameyuṣī tena tatra punareṣi viśramam || 46 ||
unmanīṃ smarati yastavākṛtiṃ siddhavartmani jayatyasau janaḥ || 48 ||
yaḥ prakāśa iha sa tvayā kṛtaḥ tattadākṛtirūpaiti sṛṣṭitām || 49 ||
śiṣyase yadi vinārthamaṇḍalaṃ sargasīmani kuto'sti cittatā || 50 ||
cittadākṛtinirākṛtiḥ svato bhāti yā sakṛdasau tvameva sā || 54 ||
tvaṃ tu jāḍyaparipanthinī smṛtā yā vibhāsi sakṛdarthamaṇḍale || 55 ||
sā tvamamba ! na bibharṣi bhāsyatāṃ bhātmano yadasi dharma īśituḥ || 56 ||
nirmalajvalanaśaucavajjagat tatra hi tviṣi nimajjitaṃ tvayā || 58 ||
grāhakatvamapi niścitagrahe vettyataḥ sa tava vṛttipoṣitaḥ || 60 ||
arpaṇena jagataścidambare bhāti saṃhṛtimayaḥ śive tava || 62 ||
ṣaṭ tvayā pṛthagamī pravartakāḥ putrabhāvamadhiropitāḥ śive || 65 ||
turyacitpadamayuḥ prasāritāḥ suptitaḥ prabhṛti dhāmasu triṣu || 71 ||
tadvaśena bhajate paramparāṃ tāvakī kramatayā sphuṭākṛtiḥ || 73 ||
yattadollasati vīryamūrjitaṃ pīṭha eṣa hi mahāṃstvadutthitaḥ || 76 ||
sā mahad bhavati vīryamagrimaṃ yanmayī tvamasi pīṭhacakrasūḥ || 77 ||
antyamīśamasi taṃ tridhāmakaṃ varṇaśaktipadavī ca citkalā || 79 ||
pīṭhataḥ prabhṛti yāvadarcyate tāvadunmiṣati tanmayī satī || 80 ||
